tagline: Understand your data before changing it.
intro: Bring a spreadsheet, find the gaps, and inspect the details in one workspace.
demoNote: No account needed. Sample data is synthetic. Guest workspaces expire after 2 hours.
chooseFile: Choose a CSV or Excel file
fileHelp: CSV or XLSX · Up to 5 MB, 10,000 rows and 100 columns. Original values are preserved.
emptyHint: Import a file or open the sample to see its quality checks.
selectDataset: Select a dataset to inspect its quality.
deleteConfirm: Delete this dataset and its stored source file? This cannot be undone.
qualityNote: Types are suggestions based on column names and observed values. Outliers are warnings, not confirmed errors. Data is never changed automatically.
guestAccount: Guest workspaces do not have a password. Ask the operator for a permanent account.
help1: Choose the sales sample or import your CSV/XLSX. For a workbook with several sheets, select one worksheet.
help2: Open Data quality to inspect missing values, duplicates and values that need review. IDs keep their original leading zeros.
help3: Open Clean & export to preview and confirm a recipe. Save it as a workflow to run with new files. Review the result before applying and exporting.
help4: Your guest data is isolated from other visitors. It expires after 2 hours and is removed when guest cleanup runs. Do not upload personal or confidential information to a public guest workspace.

error.xlsx_values: Some text cannot be stored in Excel without loss (control characters or more than 32,767 characters). Export JSON instead.
error.unauthorized: Please sign in or start a new guest workspace.
error.session_expired: This guest workspace has expired. Start a new one.
error.csrf: Your session changed. Reload and try again.
error.forbidden: This account cannot perform that action.
error.origin_forbidden: This website address is not allowed by the server.
error.invalid_login: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is unavailable.
error.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.invalid_file: This file could not be read. Check that it is a valid CSV or XLSX.
error.encoding: The file does not match the selected encoding. Try UTF-8 or Windows Vietnamese.
error.file_too_large: The file exceeds the upload limit.
error.dataset_limit: The spreadsheet exceeds the row or column limit.
error.workspace_limit: This workspace has reached its dataset or storage limit. Delete a dataset before importing another.
error.invalid_headers: Every column needs a non-empty name of at most 255 characters.
error.duplicate_headers: Some column names are duplicated after trimming spaces. Rename them in the source before importing.
error.empty_dataset: The file has column names but no data rows.
error.ragged_rows: Some rows have a different number of columns. Check the CSV delimiter and quoting.
error.unsupported_file: Only CSV and XLSX are supported. Macros and legacy XLS files are not accepted.
error.unsafe_workbook: This workbook contains unsupported external/macro content or exceeds safe extraction limits.
error.workbook_limit: This workbook has too many worksheets.
error.sheet_missing: The selected worksheet does not exist.
error.dataset_not_found: This dataset is unavailable or belongs to another workspace.
error.invalid_request: Check the form values and try again.
error.database_unavailable: Data storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again; your original data has not been changed.
error.stale_version: The dataset changed after this preview. Reload and preview again.
error.preview_not_found: This preview was replaced or is unavailable. Create a new preview.
error.preview_expired: This preview expired. Create a new preview.
error.preview_limit: Too many pending previews. Wait or delete an unused dataset.
error.no_changes: There are no changes to apply.
error.version_limit: The saved-version limit was reached. Export your work before creating another dataset.
error.invalid_column: A recipe column no longer exists. Check the step order.
error.invalid_values: Some values cannot be converted with these settings. Check the dates, separators and rows; no changes were applied.
error.workflow_not_found: This workflow is unavailable or belongs to another workspace.
error.right_dataset_required: Choose a different dataset for the second input.
error.empty_workflow: Add at least one cleaning step or an integration.
error.workflow_limit: The workflow limit was reached. Delete an unused workflow.
error.run_limit: The run-history limit was reached. Export your work or delete an unused workflow.
error.idempotency_conflict: This retry key was used with different inputs. Start a new run.
error.schema_drift: The input columns changed. Review the schema and save a corrected definition; nothing was applied.
error.append_schema: Append needs exactly the same column names in both datasets.
error.duplicate_join_keys: Lookup keys are duplicated. Resolve duplicates before joining.
error.missing_join_keys: The lookup dataset has empty keys. Fix them before joining.
error.unmatched_keys: Some source keys have no lookup match. Review them or explicitly allow unmatched keys.
error.execution_failed: Processing failed. No result was applied; review the inputs and try a new run.
error.execution_interrupted: Processing was interrupted. No result was applied; create a new run.

clean.instructions: Choose an operation and its columns. Build the recipe, then review the preview before applying.
clean.multipleHelp: Select one or more columns (Ctrl / Cmd for multiple).
clean.condition: Keep rows where the value is
clean.splitNames: New column names, separated by commas
clean.combineNote: Combining adds a column; missing values contribute empty text. Source columns remain.
clean.emptyRecipe: No steps yet. Changes are never applied automatically.
clean.previewNote: Up to 20 steps. Each preview replaces this dataset's previous draft and expires after 15 minutes.
clean.noChanges: This recipe does not change the current data.
clean.applyConfirm: Apply this preview as a new version? Your original file and previous versions will remain available.
clean.restoreConfirm: Switch to this version? Existing versions will remain in history.
clean.exportNote: Excel exports retain text values. CSV adds an apostrophe before formula-like values (including negative numbers) to protect spreadsheet users. Choose JSON for exact text round trips.

wf.saveHint: Save this recipe and input column structure. Optionally append or join another dataset. This saves a definition; it does not apply changes.
wf.name: Workflow name
wf.allowUnmatched: Allow unmatched source keys (left join fills blanks; inner join drops them).
wf.joinSafety: Lookup keys must be non-empty and unique. Duplicate lookup keys are rejected to prevent multiplied rows.
wf.saved: Workflow saved. Open Workflows to choose new inputs and run it.
wf.intro: Reuse a saved recipe with new files. Input columns are checked before processing; results need your confirmation.
wf.emptyHint: Open Clean & export, build a recipe and save it as a reusable workflow.
wf.deleteConfirm: Delete this workflow and its run history? Dataset versions already applied will remain.
wf.runNote: The current input versions are captured when the run is created. Processing produces a preview; no values are applied automatically.
wf.joinCounts: Matched source rows: {{matched}} · Unmatched: {{unmatched}} · Unused lookup rows: {{unused}}
wf.resultNote: Apply to save a dataset version, then export it from Clean & export.
wf.noRuns: This workflow has not been run yet.
wf.updateHint: Choose the reference inputs above. The new version uses their current column structure and the saved transformation steps. Old definitions and runs remain unchanged.
wf.updateConfirm: Save a new workflow version using these reference inputs?
wf.draftNote: Step edits affect the draft only. Save a new version before running it; disabled steps are omitted from the new version.
